paite: Huan sialluang chiang bang tehna chiang khat piak in ka om a; angel in, "Thou inla, Pathian tempul leh maitam leh huai a bete teh in;
heading: Theihpihtu Nihte
english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise, and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

paite: tempul huangsung polam ahihleh nusia inla, teh ke'n; Zentelte kiang a piaksa ahih tak ziak in; huan kho siangthou akhenuai un kha sawmli-le-nih sung asikden ding uhi.
english: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

paite: Huan ka theihpihtu nihte kiang ah thilhihtheihna ka pe dia, amau sai-ip puan silh in ni sangkhat zanih-le-sawmguk thu agenkhol ding uh achi hi."
english: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

paite: Hiaite olive sing nihte leh khawnvak koihna nihte, leitung a Toupa ma a dinghte ahi uhi.
english: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

paite: Mi kuapeuh in amau suknat atup ualeh, akam ua kipan a mei hong suakkhia in amelmate akangtum vek dia; kuapeuh in amau hihnat atup ualeh huchibang a thah in a-om ding uhi.
english: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

paite: Hiai mite'n athugenkholh sung ua vuah azuklouhna ding in, van khaktheihna anei ua; huan a-ut hunhun ua sisan suaksak ding in tuite tung ah thu anei ua, leitung leng gawtna chiteng a gawt ding in thu anei uhi.
english: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

paite: Huan atheihpihna nasep uh azoh chiang un, kokhuk taw nei lou a kipan a hong pawtkhia huai gamsa in amau akidoupih ding a, amau azou dia, athat ding hi.
english: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

paite: Asiluang uh khopi thupi kongzing ah akisial a, huai khalam thu ah Sodom leh Aigupta kichi, kros a Toupa kilhlup a a-omna mah ahi.
english: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

paite: Mite leh chite leh paute leh namte lak a kipan mite aluang uh ni thum-le-akim a-en ua, aluang uh han a vui aphal kei uhi.
english: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

paite: Huchi in leitung a tengte amaute tung a kisial in akipak ua, kipahna abawl ua; thilpiakte akikhaktuah ua; hiai zawlnei nihte'n amau leitung a tengte athuakgimsak khit tak ziak un.
english: Those who dwell on the earth rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

paite: Huan ni thum-le-akim nung in, Pathian a kipan in hinna hatna amau ah ahong lut a, akhe un adingh uhi; amau mu tengteng tung ah nakpi a launa ahong omta hi.
english: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

paite: Van a kipan in aw thupitak aza ua, "Hiai ah hong paitou un," chi in. Huan amau meipi lak ah van ah apaitou uhi; amelmate un amau amu chiat uhi.
english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies saw them.

paite: Huai dak in zinling thupitak ahong om a, khopi mun sawm a khen mun khat achim hi. Huai zinling ah mi sangsagih thah in a-om ua; adangte'n alau ua, van a Pathian kiang ah thupina apia uhi.
english: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

paite: Tunggikna nihna abeita a; ngai in, tunggikna thumna ahong tung pah ding hi.
english: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

paite: Huan angel sagihna in apengkul amut a; van ah aw thupitak in, "Khovel lalgam tuh i Toupa leh a Khrist a ahong hita hi; ama'n tangtawn in vai ahawm ding," achi uhi.
heading: Pengkul Sagihte
english: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

paite: Upa sawmnih-le-li, laltutphah tung a Pathian ma a tute'n amai ua lei si in Pathian abia uhi.
english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

paite: "Na tung ah ka kipak uhi, Toupa Pathian Bangkim hihthei, omlel leh omsa leh hong om ding; na thilhihtheihna thupi na lak tak ziak in leh vai na hawm tak ziak in,
english: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was TR adds “and who is coming” ; because you have taken your great power, and reigned.

paite: Namte aheh ua, tu in nang thangpaihna ni ahong tung hi, misite vai na hawmsak hun leh na sikha zawlneite leh misiangthoute kiang leh na min kihtate milian leh mineute kiang a kipahman na piakna hun leh leitung hihsete hihsiat a a-om sam hun uh ahong tungta hi," achi uhi.
english: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints, and those who fear your name, to the small and the great; and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

paite: Huan van a om Pathian tempul hon in a-om a; atempul sung ah thukhun bawm ahong kimu hi; huchi in khophiate, awte, van-gingte, zinlingte leh gial thupitak in azui ngal hi.
english: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.
